Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship Details

The GCUB International Mobility Program – Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship is promoted by GCUB, with the support of the Instituto Guimarães Rosa of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil.

The Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship (GCUB) 2026 aims to contribute to the development of high-academic-level students from the five continents, as well as promoting university internationalization and strengthening international cooperation between Brazilian universities and institutions of other countries.

More than 800 master’s and doctoral degree scholarships will be awarded in this edition, by 55 Brazilian universities, whose programs will begin in 2025.

Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship Benefits

  • Exemption from paying enrollment fees, tuition, or academic fees.

  • A Monthly Stipend to cover the living expenses for the full duration of the program.

  • Students who will receive GCUB scholarships from OSC member states will get up to USD 1,500 per airfare, visa processing, international medical insurance, and other personal expenses.

Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship (GCUB) 2026 Requirements

To be eligible for the postgraduate Group of Brazilian Universities Scholarship (GCUB) 2026, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

Student loan information

  • Submit the complete application in English, Portuguese, French, or Spanish.

  • The scholarship is open to citizens of a country that maintains a diplomatic relationship with Brazil.

  • Brazilian Nationals are not eligible.

  • Be able to finance other costs such as Airfare, Visa processing, and health insurance not covered under the scholarship.

  • Must observe the language requirements of the Graduate Programs for which they apply

  • Submit the  educational documents.

  • Each candidate can apply for five Master’s or Doctoral programs in different universities.

Required Documents for Group of Brazilian Universities GCUB Scholarship 2026

While applying for the Group of Brazilian Universities GCUB Scholarship, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Application Form 

  • Copy of Passport or any other identity document

  • CV

  • Copy of all previous educational certificates, diplomas, transcripts, and degrees.

  • Submit an essay and follow the structure:
